title: Surveying Tripod and Level
description: Reusable tripod-and-level component with explicit instrument height, sight-axis elevation, and surveying azimuth.
learningObjectives: Identify instrument height and line of sight for a leveled surveying instrument.
Interpret surveying azimuth as clockwise from north and convert it to the LearnMat coordinate basis.

rights.attribution: Original LearnMat repository contribution; no third-party visual assets or runtime dependencies.

verification.notes: Instrument-height and azimuth-vector invariants reviewed from source; browser and assistive-technology checks remain.
